d: Colony worlds and alien territories from Larry Niven’s Known Space series.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: First extrasolar human colony world, orbiting Alpha Centauri; occupied and strip-mined by the felinoid Kzinti during the First Man-Kzin War.

hip-32349.x: Massive, egg-shaped moon of a gas giant at Sirius; high equatorial gravity holds a dense atmosphere while polar peaks protrude into vacuum.

hip-37279.x: Procyon colony world settled by Crashlanders, swept by 1,500 km/h winds due to its extreme rotational tilt.

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Habitable plateau rising 40 miles above the Venus-like pressure cooker of Tau Ceti II, ruled by organ-transplant tyrants in A Gift from Earth.

gaia-6412595290592307840.x: Idyllic Earth-like agricultural world in the Epsilon Indi system, devastated during the Pak Protector fleet invasion.

b.s: Classic hard sci-fi universe charting humanity’s expansion, the Man-Kzin Wars, and the discovery of the Ringworld.
